summary: Replaced the `beforeRegisterNodeDef` + `onExecuted` prototype patch with `comfy.defs.extend(...).onExecuted`, and the `this.widgets.length = pos` truncation (plus its manual `onRemove()` loop) with `node.widgets.remove(name)` per widget from "result" onwards. The readout is now `node.widgets.add({ type: 'textarea', disabled: true })` instead of `ComfyWidgets["STRING"]` plus `inputEl.readOnly`/`opacity`; the value is passed through as `result.raw.text`, byte-identical to the old `message.text`. Dropped `this.onResize?.(this.size)` — it passes the unchanged size, so it only re-notifies a handler ShowText/StringFunction never install, and widget growth is now handled by `expandToFitContent`.

results.detail: No net-new members outside the API.
